name: Grand Ballroom
summary: Our largest indoor hall, made for grand weddings, receptions and big corporate evenings.
description: The Grand Ballroom pairs a built-in stage with chandeliers, a high ceiling and full air-conditioning. It works just as well for a 500-guest reception dinner as for an awards night, with plenty of room for buffet counters, a dance floor and a photo corner.

name: Garden Lawn
summary: An open-air lawn for winter weddings, evening receptions and festive gatherings.
description: The Garden Lawn gives you a green, open setting under the sky, with room for a mandap, a stage, live food counters and a separate entry for guests. Canopies can be arranged for shade or the occasional winter shower.

name: Elegance Hall
